* Product Development and Design

  inception through conception and engineering design to product development.

  from existing physical objects.

# CNC Machine Tool Probing & On-Machine Metrology Software | AAT3D

**AAT3D** enables shop floor automation with cutting tool and dimensional inspection solutions for
direct integration on world class CNC machine tools, enabling in-process measurement, adaptive
control, and real-time feedback without interrupting machining cycles.

**CAPPS-NC** reduces setup and machining tool while minimizing and reducing scrap in pursuit of the
optimum part quality. This is achieved by integration of proven workflows and best in-class probing
solutions.

• Seamless integration with CAD/CAM systems and digital twin environments
• Precision alignments utilizing CAD and GD&T
• Working tool offsets
• Micron measurement accuracy using on-machine probing
• Native support for part alignment, toolpath verification, and wear compensation
• Measure-cut-measure work flows for the optimum cut and perfect finish
• NC-FIT closed loop tool path updates
• Comprehensive CMM style dimensional inspection reports
• Reduction of scrap and rework through live statistical process control
‍

**CAPPS-NC** supports probing routines and closed-loop inspection fully integrated in machines from
leaders such as  **DMG MORI, Mazak, Okuma, Makino, Haas, Zimmermann and Thermwood, CAPPS-NC**
enables:

Designed for high-precision manufacturing in aerospace, automotive, and energy sectors, **CAPPS-NC**
helps achieve tighter tolerances, faster cycle times, and greater process reliability—directly at
the spindle.

repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

#### Company

## COORD3 CMM

Our industrial metrology systems are used by small, medium and large companies around the world to
**certify and improve the quality of their products**.

Our CMMs can rely on a **wide variety of measurement software** and among them, **TouchDMIS is our
main software,** which features  a 100% simple touch interface that includes the TouchCAD fast
programming module. TouchDMIS™ also supports both touch and laser scanning probes, thus expanding
your metrology kit by only a single software package.

**COORD3 boasts a range of CMMs that includes more than 35 automatic and manual models**, from
inexpensive benchtop CMMs for inspecting small parts to some of the largest Gantry CMMs ever
produced. COORD3’s CMMs are in active in the aerospace, defense and heavy industries and making us
**proud of our work**.

# Blog




### [Script Hook V for Enhanced][9]

Published on Mar 23, 2025

**[ScriptHookV][10]** now supports recently released GTA V Enhanced. ASI script plugins for the
legacy version of the game are compatibile with the enhanced one, while still expect for some mods
to require an enhanced update in particular. Have fun !

### [CLEO Android, major update][11]

Published on Apr 4, 2021

I finally updated **[CLEO Android][12]** to support the latest versions of GTA III (v1.8), VC
(v1.09) and SA (v2.00), now the library supports GTA LCS (v2.2, v2.4), additionally the library has
been ported on PSP/PPSSPP to support both LCS and VCS, covering the whole set of RW-based GTA games.
The library is enhanced with plugin support now, allowing to add custom script opcodes and even more
using a simple crossplatform SDK (Android/PSP).

The project's library (libcleo.so) c++ sources are [public][13] now (2024).

### [Script Hook RDR2 is released][14]

Published on Nov 14, 2019

**[Script Hook RDR2][15]** with the **Native Trainer** are finally released ! Have fun !

### [Fallout 4 Shadow Boost is released][16]

Published on Nov 21, 2015

Users have noticed that in some locations of [Fallout 4][17] fps gets low even with a good hardware,
mostly it happens in the areas with lots of objects, [**Shadow Booost**][18] plugin is aimed to
change that. This plugin adds an ability to dynamically control shadow draw distance depending on
desired user defined fps. Make sure to test it out!

### [GTA V Classic Handling released][19]

Published on May 23, 2015

GTA V features almost arcade car controls and physics, [Classic Handling][20] makes it the way it
was in IV. Based on original IV handling, applies only to cars, including dlc ones. Enjoy!

### [Script Hook is released][21]

Published on Apr 23, 2015

**[Script Hook V][22]** is released among with the **Native Trainer** ! Have fun with GTA V guys !

### [GTA V Native Database][23]

Published on Mar 5, 2015

[NATIVE DB][24] is launched! This project is aimed to gather every piece of information about script
native functions that we have, think of it as of native wiki where anyone who wants to contribute
can do so and everyone who needs the latest script documentation or the header with natives for
ScriptHook can get it right there!

### [CLEO update][25]

Published on Dec 5, 2014

Update for [CLEO][26] is here! Latest version of GTA San Andreas is fully supported now, library
compatibility is improved! Also GTA San Andreas cheats script supports 3gb RAM devices now.

# Blog




### [Script Hook V for Enhanced][9]

Published on Mar 23, 2025

**[ScriptHookV][10]** now supports recently released GTA V Enhanced. ASI script plugins for the
legacy version of the game are compatibile with the enhanced one, while still expect for some mods
to require an enhanced update in particular. Have fun !

### [CLEO Android, major update][11]

Published on Apr 4, 2021

I finally updated **[CLEO Android][12]** to support the latest versions of GTA III (v1.8), VC
(v1.09) and SA (v2.00), now the library supports GTA LCS (v2.2, v2.4), additionally the library has
been ported on PSP/PPSSPP to support both LCS and VCS, covering the whole set of RW-based GTA games.
The library is enhanced with plugin support now, allowing to add custom script opcodes and even more
using a simple crossplatform SDK (Android/PSP).

The project's library (libcleo.so) c++ sources are [public][13] now (2024).

### [Script Hook RDR2 is released][14]

Published on Nov 14, 2019

**[Script Hook RDR2][15]** with the **Native Trainer** are finally released ! Have fun !

### [Fallout 4 Shadow Boost is released][16]

Published on Nov 21, 2015

Users have noticed that in some locations of [Fallout 4][17] fps gets low even with a good hardware,
mostly it happens in the areas with lots of objects, [**Shadow Booost**][18] plugin is aimed to
change that. This plugin adds an ability to dynamically control shadow draw distance depending on
desired user defined fps. Make sure to test it out!

### [GTA V Classic Handling released][19]

Published on May 23, 2015

GTA V features almost arcade car controls and physics, [Classic Handling][20] makes it the way it
was in IV. Based on original IV handling, applies only to cars, including dlc ones. Enjoy!

### [Script Hook is released][21]

Published on Apr 23, 2015

**[Script Hook V][22]** is released among with the **Native Trainer** ! Have fun with GTA V guys !

### [GTA V Native Database][23]

Published on Mar 5, 2015

[NATIVE DB][24] is launched! This project is aimed to gather every piece of information about script
native functions that we have, think of it as of native wiki where anyone who wants to contribute
can do so and everyone who needs the latest script documentation or the header with natives for
ScriptHook can get it right there!

### [CLEO update][25]

Published on Dec 5, 2014

Update for [CLEO][26] is here! Latest version of GTA San Andreas is fully supported now, library
compatibility is improved! Also GTA San Andreas cheats script supports 3gb RAM devices now.

## Digital Surf has been developing surface imaging & metrology software for profilers and
## microscopes since 1989

Our main focus is on working as a partner with instrument manufacturers worldwide, in the fields of
surface metrology and microscopy. Mountains® software is now offered by the majority of profilometer
and microscope manufacturers and is embedded in their equipment or available as an option.

Digital Surf also provides Mountains® software packages directly to instrument users. Mountains® has
an installed base of 26,000+ licenses worldwide, is available in 11 languages, supports ISO and
national metrology standards and is supplied by 50+ instrument manufacturers.

Application areas include: automotive, materials science, semiconductors, medical, aerospace, MEMS,
renewable energy, etc.

[Learn more][53]

### When SEM images become measurable 3D surfaces

July 10, 2026

By combining two SEM images acquired at different tilt angles, it is possible to reconstruct a true
3D surface and extract quantitative measurements. One important question remains for many SEM users:
can height values of reconstructed SEM topography be trusted? A recent comparison performed on
femtosecond laser-machined metallic samples provides a compelling answer.

## Unlocking Precision Excellence: Explore Our Services

Welcome to ECM Global Measurement Solutions, where precision meets expertise. With a legacy dating
back to 2001, we have established ourselves as industry leaders in measurement and alignment
services. Our laser tracker services deploy field engineers for short and long-term projects,
delivering unparalleled expertise directly to your doorstep. Meanwhile, our onsite precision for
industrial applications specializes in large-scale projects, ranging from aircraft and power plants
to yachts and bridges. Our seasoned metrologists bring precision to every corner, equipped with the
perfect tools for capturing onsite data, ensuring seamless post-processing, and delivering
comprehensive reports. Trust ECM for precision that goes beyond boundaries.

### Precision Measurement & Alignment

In virtually every industrial application, the benefits of highly precise measurement solutions are
paramount. In situations where even a deviation of a thousandth of an inch could have adverse
effects on quality, ECM is equipped with specialized tools and expertise to deliver prompt,
accurate, and consistent metrology solutions.

[Learn More][37]

### Accredited Instrument Calibrations

Calibrated metrology instruments are crucial in situations where even the slightest deviation from
technical specifications can result in catastrophic outcomes such as equipment failure, accidents,
or significant financial loss. An ISO/IEC 17025 accredited instrument calibration guarantees the
consistent delivery of accurate results and minimizes errors during critical applications. By
adhering to a predefined calibration schedule, you mitigate the risk of inaccurate measurements and
enhance the longevity of your measuring system.

[Learn More][38]

### Training & Certification

Our training programs are designed to equip you with the knowledge and expertise required for
assembly, manufacturing, and quality assurance roles. You’ll also gain insights into the intricacies
of typical inspection tasks, ensuring you’re well-prepared for real-world challenges. Join us and
elevate your proficiency in ECM with our dynamic and application-focused curriculum.

[Learn More][39]

### LiDar Scanning for AEC Industry

ECM brings a new standard of quality to dimensional measurement through a combination of
best-in-class 3D technologies, proven metrology processes, application specific expertise and the
right balance of after service support. Whether servicing small manufacturers or leading companies
across a diverse range of industries, we take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive
solutions to meet clients’ architectural, engineering, and construction support needs.

[Learn More][40]

### Industry Applications

Drawing on vast expertise across aerospace, automotive, marine, medical, power generation,
manufacturing, and diverse industries, ECM partners with businesses of all sizes, from local
enterprises to Fortune 500 giants. From micro-components to massive structures, our extensive suite
of measuring tools ensures we meet each customer’s distinct needs. Our pledge is to deliver precise
measurements customized to your specifications, regardless of your business’s scale or sector. At
ECM, we prioritize your quality requirements above all else.

## Contact Minds Mechanical

Close Submit

### What We Do

Minds Mechanical is a manufacturing, metrology, and integration company. Our foundational commitment
to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.

We specialize in precision manufacturing, metrology, 3D measurement equipment and software, and
industrial automation. We are an experienced team of engineers, metrologists, and machinists
providing end-to-end production and quality solutions.

[Minds Mechanical Logo - Graphic white brain made of gears]

### Our services

Driven By Quality, Built For Excellence

### IMI - Intelligent Manufacturing and Inspections

Minds Mechanical’s proprietary flagship software, created in-house by a team of engineers,
metrologists, and developers.

IMI bridges the divide between the manufacturing lifecycle and quality, bringing all aspects of the
production process under one roof.

IMI is an end-to-end Part Lifecycle Management (PLM) system built from the ground up to streamline
the manufacturing and quality processes. Host entire projects securely in the cloud, linking parts
and assemblies with their associated models, guides, and reports – accessible from any device at the
office or in the field.

A robust analytics suite and machine data accuracy feedback increase operational efficiency and help
you stay on top of calibrations.

[Get a closer look][11]
[Minds Mechanical Logo - Large Orange Letters That Spell IMI]

### Industrial Automation

We specialize in high accuracy industrial automation systems integration, from design to facility
set up with metrology-based installation. Services include complete part sourcing, hardware
integration, PLC programming, custom cabling, and shielding.

Our team of experienced engineers provide efficient, cost-effective solutions for automation across
a wide range of applications.

[See what's involved][12]

### Metrology Services

Our foundational commitment to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.
We specialize in high accuracy 3D inspection and analysis services.

Minds Mechanical provides comprehensive metrology solutions, including consultation, final
verification and analysis, equipment rentals, and metrology software and training.

Our team of experienced metrology technicians adhere to the highest standards of quality and utilize
the latest 3D inspection hardware and software to provide full visibility into part or tooling
condition.

[Read More][13]

### Full Service Manufacturing

Minds Mechanical offers state of the art, end-to-end manufacturing solutions. We have the experience
and capability to machine parts for aerospace, industrial manufacturing, marine and automobile
applications, prototyping, and more.

Our professional operators offer a full range of fabrication and machining services in stainless,
aluminum, and steel with a wide variety of available equipment.

[Read More][14]

## About Us

Minds Mechanical is a manufacturing, metrology, and integration company. Our foundational commitment
to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.

We specialize in precision manufacturing, metrology, 3D measurement equipment and software, and
industrial automation. We are an experienced team of engineers, metrologists, and machinists
providing end-to-end production and quality solutions.

## Präzisionsmesstechnik

### für Industrie und Wissenschaft

Seit mehr als 30 Jahren zählt SIOS zu den führenden Unternehmen der präzisen Messtechnik. Wir bieten
Ihnen qualitativ hochwertige Standardsensoren sowie kundenspezifische OEM-Lösungen, z. B. für die
Bereiche Forschung & Entwicklung, Kalibrierwesen, Maschinenbau, Optik- und Halbleiterindustrie,
Medizintechnik, Nanomesstechnik und Geowissenschaft.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][33]

[[Laserinterferometer: Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS]][34]

## PRECISION IN MEASUREMENT

### Made in Germany

**SIOS entwickelt und fertigt laserinterferometrische Messtechnik und Präzisionsmessgeräte für die
Kalibrier- und Nanomesstechnik zur Messung von Länge, Winkel, Schwingung, Geradheit, Temperatur,
Kraft und weitere Messgrößen mit höchster Auflösung und geringer Messunsicherheit.**

**Messtechniker, Qualitätsprüfer, Ingenieure, Wissenschaftler und Einkäufer auf der ganzen Welt
vertrauen der Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS.**

[[Hochgenaue Präzisions-Messsysteme von SIOS im Überblick]][35]

### [ Produkte ][36]

Finden Sie das passende SIOS-Produkt für Ihre Messaufgabe: von der hochgenauen Längenmessung über
die kontinuierliche 6-DOF-Messung bis hin zur Messung von Nanostrukturen mit Hilfe von
Laserinterferometern, Laservibrometern, Messtastern, Nanomesstechnik, stabilisierten Lasern,
Klimamesstechnik.

[ SIOS Messsysteme ][37]
[[Anwendungen: In welchen Bereiche wird die Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS eingesetzt?]][38]

### [ Anwendungen ][39]

Erfahren Sie mehr über die vielfältigen Anwendungsmöglichkeiten unserer Geräte in der Praxis.
Messtechnik von SIOS wird immer dann eingesetzt, wenn es um präzise und verlässliche Messergebnisse
geht, z. B. für die Maschinenkalibrierung, Qualitätssicherung, Oberflächenmessung, Messungen im
Vakuum …

[ SIOS Anwendungen ][40]
[[OEM-Service: Maßgefertigte Präzisionsmesstechnik für individuelle Kundenwünsche]][41]

### [ OEM-Service ][42]

Individuelle Lösungen sind unsere Stärke. Dank unserer langjährigen Expertise, hohen Flexibilität
sowie dem modularen Aufbau unserer Messsysteme entwickeln wir maßgefertigte Lösung für spezielle
Kundenanforderungen. Davon profitieren insbesondere unsere Kunden im OEM-Bereich.

[ OEM-Lösungen ][43]

## Internationale Vertretungen

### Die Nähe zu unseren Kunden ist uns wichtig

Mit **23 Vertretungen für 30 Ländern** können wir Sie optimal und umfassend betreuen. Unsere
Vertriebspartner kommunizieren mit Ihnen sowohl technisch als auch sprachlich auf Augenhöhe. Sie
kennen die lokalen Marktanforderungen und kulturellen Besonderheiten.
Unsere Partner verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrungen im Bereich Laser interferometrische
Messtechnik und finden die perfekte Lösung für Ihre individuellen Herausforderungen.

Mahr | The Company

## **Welcome** to Mahr

One company, a variety of products, passionate employees: that is Mahr. As a global supplier of
production metrology, rotary stroke bearings and gear metering pumps as well as meter mix dispense
technology, the Mahr Group has the right solution for a wide range of applications. You can rely on
our technical innovation and the expertise we have gained in over 160 years of company history.

## Our Corporate Divisions

[[Nahaufnahme eines Getriebes]][58]
Mahr | Metrology

#### [Modern metrology][59]

As a manufacturer of innovative measuring technology, we support our customers in the measuring room
and in production. A total of almost 160 years of experience has gone into our products – from
manual calipers to fully automated measuring stations. This experience has made us experts in
quality assurance in many industries.

[Go to business unit][60]
[[Nahaufnahme eines Mischkopfs]][61]
Mahr | Metering Systems

#### [High-precision metering pumps, meter mix dispense technology][62]

When processing liquids and pastes, customers all over the world rely on the metering accuracy of
our gear metering pumps and meter mix dispense machines. Mahr metering technology is used wherever
maximum precision and efficiency are required.

[Go to business unit][63]
[[Nahaufnahme MarMotion]][64]
Mahr | MarMotion

#### [Rotary stroke bearings with a sense of precision][65]

Targeted and repeatable movements: MarMotion rotary stroke bearings constantly offer new customized
solutions across all industries. The precision guides made of hardened steel boast a long service
life and master all rotary and linear movements with ease.

direct integration on world class CNC machine tools, enabling in-process measurement, adaptive
control, and real-time feedback without interrupting machining cycles.

optimum part quality. This is achieved by integration of proven workflows and best in-class probing

#### Company

## COORD3 CMM

Our industrial metrology systems are used by small, medium and large companies around the world to
**certify and improve the quality of their products**.

Our CMMs can rely on a **wide variety of measurement software** and among them, **TouchDMIS is our
main software,** which features  a 100% simple touch interface that includes the TouchCAD fast
programming module. TouchDMIS™ also supports both touch and laser scanning probes, thus expanding
your metrology kit by only a single software package.

**COORD3 boasts a range of CMMs that includes more than 35 automatic and manual models**, from
inexpensive benchtop CMMs for inspecting small parts to some of the largest Gantry CMMs ever
produced. COORD3’s CMMs are in active in the aerospace, defense and heavy industries and making us
**proud of our work**.

### [Script Hook V for Enhanced][9]

Published on Mar 23, 2025

**[ScriptHookV][10]** now supports recently released GTA V Enhanced. ASI script plugins for the
legacy version of the game are compatibile with the enhanced one, while still expect for some mods
to require an enhanced update in particular. Have fun !

### [CLEO Android, major update][11]

Published on Apr 4, 2021

I finally updated **[CLEO Android][12]** to support the latest versions of GTA III (v1.8), VC
(v1.09) and SA (v2.00), now the library supports GTA LCS (v2.2, v2.4), additionally the library has
been ported on PSP/PPSSPP to support both LCS and VCS, covering the whole set of RW-based GTA games.
The library is enhanced with plugin support now, allowing to add custom script opcodes and even more
using a simple crossplatform SDK (Android/PSP).

The project's library (libcleo.so) c++ sources are [public][13] now (2024).

## Digital Surf has been developing surface imaging & metrology software for profilers and
## microscopes since 1989

Our main focus is on working as a partner with instrument manufacturers worldwide, in the fields of
surface metrology and microscopy. Mountains® software is now offered by the majority of profilometer
and microscope manufacturers and is embedded in their equipment or available as an option.

Digital Surf also provides Mountains® software packages directly to instrument users. Mountains® has
an installed base of 26,000+ licenses worldwide, is available in 11 languages, supports ISO and
national metrology standards and is supplied by 50+ instrument manufacturers.

Application areas include: automotive, materials science, semiconductors, medical, aerospace, MEMS,
renewable energy, etc.

## Unlocking Precision Excellence: Explore Our Services

Welcome to ECM Global Measurement Solutions, where precision meets expertise. With a legacy dating
back to 2001, we have established ourselves as industry leaders in measurement and alignment
services. Our laser tracker services deploy field engineers for short and long-term projects,
delivering unparalleled expertise directly to your doorstep. Meanwhile, our onsite precision for
industrial applications specializes in large-scale projects, ranging from aircraft and power plants
to yachts and bridges. Our seasoned metrologists bring precision to every corner, equipped with the
perfect tools for capturing onsite data, ensuring seamless post-processing, and delivering
comprehensive reports. Trust ECM for precision that goes beyond boundaries.

### Precision Measurement & Alignment

In virtually every industrial application, the benefits of highly precise measurement solutions are
paramount. In situations where even a deviation of a thousandth of an inch could have adverse
effects on quality, ECM is equipped with specialized tools and expertise to deliver prompt,
accurate, and consistent metrology solutions.

[Learn More][37]

### Accredited Instrument Calibrations

Calibrated metrology instruments are crucial in situations where even the slightest deviation from
technical specifications can result in catastrophic outcomes such as equipment failure, accidents,
or significant financial loss. An ISO/IEC 17025 accredited instrument calibration guarantees the
consistent delivery of accurate results and minimizes errors during critical applications. By
adhering to a predefined calibration schedule, you mitigate the risk of inaccurate measurements and
enhance the longevity of your measuring system.

[Learn More][38]

### Training & Certification

Our training programs are designed to equip you with the knowledge and expertise required for
assembly, manufacturing, and quality assurance roles. You’ll also gain insights into the intricacies
of typical inspection tasks, ensuring you’re well-prepared for real-world challenges. Join us and
elevate your proficiency in ECM with our dynamic and application-focused curriculum.

adhering to a predefined calibration schedule, you mitigate the risk of inaccurate measurements and
enhance the longevity of your measuring system.

# InspectProHQ — Home Inspection Software with AI-Assisted Reports

InspectProHQ is professional home inspection software built to help inspectors finish reports
on-site. Powered by AI comment generation, a 300+ built-in defect library, and photo documentation
tools, InspectProHQ is the modern solution for residential and commercial property inspections.

## AI-Powered Report Writing

Generate accurate inspection comments instantly with AI. InspectProHQ's intelligent defect
recognition and voice-to-text tools let you complete reports on-site, saving hours of office work.
Fully compliant with InterNACHI, ASHI, and NANI standards.

## Client & Realtor Portals

Deliver professional inspection reports through branded client and realtor portals. Clients can
review findings, sign agreements with e-signatures, and access their HomeOwner Hub for ongoing
maintenance guidance.

## Scheduling & Invoicing

Manage your entire inspection business from one platform. Online scheduling, automated email
confirmations, Stripe-powered invoicing, and a public booking calendar make it easy to stay
organized and get paid faster.

## Built for Professional Home Inspectors

Whether you perform residential, commercial, 4-point, wind mitigation, or WDO inspections,
InspectProHQ has purpose-built templates and tools. Multi-inspector teams, offline mobile access,
and Excel data exports are included at every tier. Free to start — no credit card required.

### What We Do

Minds Mechanical is a manufacturing, metrology, and integration company. Our foundational commitment
to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.

We specialize in precision manufacturing, metrology, 3D measurement equipment and software, and
industrial automation. We are an experienced team of engineers, metrologists, and machinists
providing end-to-end production and quality solutions.

[Minds Mechanical Logo - Graphic white brain made of gears]

### Our services

Driven By Quality, Built For Excellence

### IMI - Intelligent Manufacturing and Inspections

Minds Mechanical’s proprietary flagship software, created in-house by a team of engineers,
metrologists, and developers.

IMI bridges the divide between the manufacturing lifecycle and quality, bringing all aspects of the
production process under one roof.

IMI is an end-to-end Part Lifecycle Management (PLM) system built from the ground up to streamline
the manufacturing and quality processes. Host entire projects securely in the cloud, linking parts
and assemblies with their associated models, guides, and reports – accessible from any device at the
office or in the field.

A robust analytics suite and machine data accuracy feedback increase operational efficiency and help
you stay on top of calibrations.

[Get a closer look][11]
[Minds Mechanical Logo - Large Orange Letters That Spell IMI]

### Industrial Automation

We specialize in high accuracy industrial automation systems integration, from design to facility
set up with metrology-based installation. Services include complete part sourcing, hardware
integration, PLC programming, custom cabling, and shielding.

Our team of experienced engineers provide efficient, cost-effective solutions for automation across
a wide range of applications.

[See what's involved][12]

### Metrology Services

Our foundational commitment to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.
We specialize in high accuracy 3D inspection and analysis services.

Minds Mechanical provides comprehensive metrology solutions, including consultation, final
verification and analysis, equipment rentals, and metrology software and training.

Our team of experienced metrology technicians adhere to the highest standards of quality and utilize
the latest 3D inspection hardware and software to provide full visibility into part or tooling
condition.

[Read More][13]

### Full Service Manufacturing

Minds Mechanical offers state of the art, end-to-end manufacturing solutions. We have the experience
and capability to machine parts for aerospace, industrial manufacturing, marine and automobile
applications, prototyping, and more.

Our professional operators offer a full range of fabrication and machining services in stainless,
aluminum, and steel with a wide variety of available equipment.

[Read More][14]

## About Us

Minds Mechanical is a manufacturing, metrology, and integration company. Our foundational commitment
to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.

We specialize in precision manufacturing, metrology, 3D measurement equipment and software, and
industrial automation. We are an experienced team of engineers, metrologists, and machinists
providing end-to-end production and quality solutions.

# Multisensor Precision at the Speed of Light

When failure isn’t an option, settle for nothing less than the best: SmartScope Quest, the ultimate
multisensor dimensional measurement systems.
[ SmartScope Quest ][111]

# The Next Evolution of SmartScope is Here

Introducing **OGP SmartScope M-Series**, featuring the patented IntelliCentric-M Optical System for
unparalleled accuracy. Streamline production when you Measure Fast and Manufacture Faster.
[ Learn More ][112]

## Welcome to OGP

OGP is the world’s largest vision metrology company, delivering dimensional measurement systems
built for exceptional accuracy and reliability. Manufacturers worldwide depend on our equipment and
expertise to guarantee product quality—let us do the same for yours. As the pioneer of multisensor
measurement, OGP introduced integrated vision, touch-probe, and laser sensors. For more than 80
years we’ve led the industry with innovative systems and sensors that solve the toughest measurement
challenges. Today, multisensor metrology remains the quality-control standard for leading
manufacturers, helping them develop, sustain, and continuously improve product quality for their
customers every day.

### Find a rep

Your local Authorized OGP Representative is ready to help you with product details, demonstrations,
training, or purchase information.

You know the parts you make better than anyone. By selecting a product category and a few
qualifiers, you can discover which OGP products and technologies offer the ideal solution for your
individual application requirements.

## Präzisionsmesstechnik

### für Industrie und Wissenschaft

Seit mehr als 30 Jahren zählt SIOS zu den führenden Unternehmen der präzisen Messtechnik. Wir bieten
Ihnen qualitativ hochwertige Standardsensoren sowie kundenspezifische OEM-Lösungen, z. B. für die
Bereiche Forschung & Entwicklung, Kalibrierwesen, Maschinenbau, Optik- und Halbleiterindustrie,
Medizintechnik, Nanomesstechnik und Geowissenschaft.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][33]

[[Laserinterferometer: Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS]][34]

## PRECISION IN MEASUREMENT

### Made in Germany

**SIOS entwickelt und fertigt laserinterferometrische Messtechnik und Präzisionsmessgeräte für die
Kalibrier- und Nanomesstechnik zur Messung von Länge, Winkel, Schwingung, Geradheit, Temperatur,
Kraft und weitere Messgrößen mit höchster Auflösung und geringer Messunsicherheit.**

**Messtechniker, Qualitätsprüfer, Ingenieure, Wissenschaftler und Einkäufer auf der ganzen Welt
vertrauen der Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS.**

[[Hochgenaue Präzisions-Messsysteme von SIOS im Überblick]][35]

### [ Produkte ][36]

Finden Sie das passende SIOS-Produkt für Ihre Messaufgabe: von der hochgenauen Längenmessung über
die kontinuierliche 6-DOF-Messung bis hin zur Messung von Nanostrukturen mit Hilfe von
Laserinterferometern, Laservibrometern, Messtastern, Nanomesstechnik, stabilisierten Lasern,
Klimamesstechnik.

[ SIOS Messsysteme ][37]
[[Anwendungen: In welchen Bereiche wird die Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS eingesetzt?]][38]

### [ Anwendungen ][39]

Erfahren Sie mehr über die vielfältigen Anwendungsmöglichkeiten unserer Geräte in der Praxis.
Messtechnik von SIOS wird immer dann eingesetzt, wenn es um präzise und verlässliche Messergebnisse
geht, z. B. für die Maschinenkalibrierung, Qualitätssicherung, Oberflächenmessung, Messungen im
Vakuum …

[ SIOS Anwendungen ][40]
[[OEM-Service: Maßgefertigte Präzisionsmesstechnik für individuelle Kundenwünsche]][41]

### [ OEM-Service ][42]

Individuelle Lösungen sind unsere Stärke. Dank unserer langjährigen Expertise, hohen Flexibilität
sowie dem modularen Aufbau unserer Messsysteme entwickeln wir maßgefertigte Lösung für spezielle
Kundenanforderungen. Davon profitieren insbesondere unsere Kunden im OEM-Bereich.

[ OEM-Lösungen ][43]

## Internationale Vertretungen

### Die Nähe zu unseren Kunden ist uns wichtig

Mit **23 Vertretungen für 30 Ländern** können wir Sie optimal und umfassend betreuen. Unsere
Vertriebspartner kommunizieren mit Ihnen sowohl technisch als auch sprachlich auf Augenhöhe. Sie
kennen die lokalen Marktanforderungen und kulturellen Besonderheiten.
Unsere Partner verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrungen im Bereich Laser interferometrische
Messtechnik und finden die perfekte Lösung für Ihre individuellen Herausforderungen.
